upstream.note: The reproduction checkout has protocol logging, seed control, and fail-closed resolution checks as local modifications; exact executed source hashes are authoritative below.

reference_condition.source: the first SPIn-NeRF binary ground-truth reference mask for each scene
reference_condition.query_scope: one scene-specific object query per run
reference_condition.operation: inverse-render the full reference mask to Gaussian rows and render that soft support into every registered camera

sam_candidate_generation.rgb_access: Every registered RGB image is opened, including evaluation/target RGB images and unlabelled views.
sam_candidate_generation.sampling_region: largest values of the rendered reference support; sample population size is int(0.4 * sum(rendered_support))
sam_candidate_generation.aggregation: elementwise mean of each SAM candidate over ten positive-point samples, followed by shared maximum normalization

candidate_to_gaussian_mapping.operation: alpha/raster-weighted all-view uplifting of the three per-view masks to an N x 3 primitive field
candidate_to_gaussian_mapping.meaning: three query-specific mask-probability hypotheses, not three semantic embedding dimensions
candidate_to_gaussian_mapping.pruning: If the carrier has more than 400000 rows, retain rows above the configured visibility-weight quantile 0.5; room is not pruned.

selection_and_scoring.candidate_policy: Choose one of the three candidates by maximum IoU on the full reference mask.
selection_and_scoring.threshold_policy: Choose k in 1..97 on the reference mask, equivalent to a rendered score threshold from 0.99 down to 0.03 after per-view min-max normalization.
selection_and_scoring.transfer: Freeze candidate id and threshold for all target frames in the scene.
selection_and_scoring.target_mask_access: Target masks are opened only during evaluation after the query field has been generated.

conclusion.primary_gap_hypothesis: The large reproduced LUDVIG-SAM advantage is primarily a strong, query-specific, target-RGB-aware SAM interface and not evidence that a persisted DINOv2/PCA40 compact relation field is stronger.
conclusion.strict_comparability: These scores are not directly equivalent to strict unseen or target-view-independent query protocols because target RGB is processed by SAM at query time. There is no target-label leakage during candidate generation.
conclusion.next_clean_attribution: Render the persisted room N x 3 candidates with the frozen RADIO-GS geometry renderer, select candidate and threshold on the reference mask only, and score targets only after predictions are persisted.
